Previously signed to Rushmore Records, the band signed to Drive-Thru to release their new record.  The album was recorded over a one-month span in the spring of 2008 at The Waiting Room Studios in North Hollywood, California.  Later that summer, the band revealed the official title and track listing, as well as the final release date.  and in mid-2008 revealed that the song "Life Won't Wait" will be the album's first single.
